Cc: Procurement <procurement@medcura.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Trial environment onboarding — high level timeline

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited. We need to lock a short, deterministic timeline for the evaluation so internal stakeholders (security, infra, procurement) can sign off. Key items for us: org seed & admin role, API key creation and rotation cadence, IP allowlist for our staging CIDRs, and VPC peering with our AWS account (acceptance window needed).

Can you propose a MAP-style schedule that ties these items to close criteria? Targeting a 3-week trial starting Nov 22 if that aligns with your availability. Also include any docs we should share with our security team up-front.

Jordan Lee

Medcura Systems

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: 2026-11-11T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial environment onboarding — high level timeline

Jordan — thanks, and glad the demo landed well. Draft MAP attached (20261120-MAP-Cadence-v1.pdf) that maps delivery milestones to acceptance criteria and sign-off owners. High level proposal: 

- Week 0 (Nov 22): Org seed + admin invite completed; API keys issued for staging (non-prod) with a read/write key and a rotated admin key. Acceptance: admin can create a model route and get a successful generation under the sample prompt set.
- Week 1 (Nov 29): IP allowlist applied (staging CIDRs) + ephemeral key test; smoke tests for latency and throughput. Acceptance: 95th percentile latency < target on sample load.
- Week 2 (Dec 6): VPC peering handshake + route table validation; customer integration test (sample pipeline). Acceptance: successful peering & end-to-end inference call from your VPC.
- Close (Dec 9): Sign-off call and optional uplift to dedicated capacity for pilot.

I've included attachments you can share with security: apikey-rotation-policy.docx and a short vpc-peering-snippet.yaml that your infra can use to pre-populate peering requests. I'll also share a SOC2 summary and our minimal evidence list in a follow-up note.

Next steps: please confirm the Nov 22 start or propose adjustments. If Procurement needs specific language for the commitment, loop them in and we'll provide a short addendum for trial terms.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medcura.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-15T14:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial environment onboarding — VPC peering details

Filing a quick operations note on peering and allowlist expectations so infra teams are aligned: 

- Redwood requires a single peering request from customer side with the account id and region; we will accept and provision a cross-account route. Please include the intended route tables and security group tags you want propagated. Sample snippet attached (vpc-peering-snippet.yaml).
- IP allowlist: provide a /28 or /27 block (we can accept specific CIDRs for staging). We'll add those to the staging ACL within 24 hours of receiving the signed MAP.
- API keys: for the trial we issue a time-bound pair (service-key + admin-key). Service-key for app calls (rotate weekly recommended); admin-key for integration tests (rotate once mid-trial). We support an automated rotation webhook if you want us to rotate and push to a secret manager endpoint.

Operational asks for Nov 22 start (what we'll need by Nov 19):
1) Org admin email(s) and intended role mappings
2) Staging CIDR(s) for allowlist
3) AWS account id + preferred region for peering
4) Point-of-contact for procurement questions (if any)

If you want, we can run a 30-minute ops preflight with your infra on Nov 20 to walk the peering flow end-to-end.

— Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Also, yes please schedule the Nov 20 ops preflight at 10:00 PT — I'll invite our infra lead. If peering requires a request from our side we'll send the filled vpc-peering-snippet.yaml back to you.

Jordan
